title: `SimplePriceOracle._getUnderlyingAddress` String Comparison Fragility & cETH Sentinel
impact: `_getUnderlyingAddress` hardcodes the `"cETH"` symbol check and a fixed sentinel `0xEeee...`. Any market whose symbol differs (e.g. `cWETH`, `cETH-v2`) falls through to `CErc20(address(cToken)).underlying()`, which reverts for a native-ETH market or returns the wrong asset. Combined with H-01, mis-keyed prices silently return `0` for the intended asset while a different asset's price is set — a price set for one market may not apply to the intended one.
